system.description:
GM marker: this creature or object radiates Unholy. Drop it on a token to mark it.

The marker shows no icon to players. It appears as a colored glow around the token — visible to the GM, and to any player whose character bears a Detection (Unholy) boon.

effects.name: Detection Aura (Unholy)
effects.description: Radiates Unholy. Perceived only through the Detection (Unholy) boon (or by the GM).
